title: a noticeable suspicious thing
description: This resource pack makes suspicious sand and suspicious gravel visible.
body:
# **Suspicious Gravel and Sand**

**This resource pack makes suspicious sand and suspicious gravel visible.
Instead of the vanilla, barely noticeable sand and gravel, it changes the block colors to blue and cyan.
For versions 1.21.6–1.21.10.
## And yes, this is my first resource pack, and I hope you like it.
I will soon be adding new resource packs on Modrinth, as well as on [curseforge](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/suspicious-gravel-and-sand)

For now, this is the first version
